scripts.build: npm run presw && tsc && vite build && npm run postbuild
scripts.build:admin: npm run presw && vite build --mode admin && powershell -Command "Copy-Item 'dist-admin/admin.html' 'dist-admin/index.html' -Force; Copy-Item 'vercel-admin.json' 'dist-admin/vercel.json' -Force; Copy-Item 'public/manifest-admin.json' 'dist-admin/manifest.json' -Force; Remove-Item 'dist-admin/manifest-admin.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item 'dist-admin/manifest-pos.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" && npm run postbuild
scripts.build:pos: npm run presw && vite build --mode pos && powershell -Command "Copy-Item 'dist-pos/pos.html' 'dist-pos/index.html' -Force; Copy-Item 'vercel-pos.json' 'dist-pos/vercel.json' -Force; Copy-Item 'public/manifest-pos.json' 'dist-pos/manifest.json' -Force; Remove-Item 'dist-pos/manifest-admin.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item 'dist-pos/manifest-pos.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" && npm run postbuild
scripts.build:all: npm run presw && tsc && vite build && vite build --mode admin && vite build --mode pos && powershell -Command "Copy-Item 'dist-admin/admin.html' 'dist-admin/index.html' -Force; Copy-Item 'vercel-admin.json' 'dist-admin/vercel.json' -Force; Copy-Item 'public/manifest-admin.json' 'dist-admin/manifest.json' -Force; Remove-Item 'dist-admin/manifest-admin.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item 'dist-admin/manifest-pos.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item 'dist-pos/pos.html' 'dist-pos/index.html' -Force; Copy-Item 'vercel-pos.json' 'dist-pos/vercel.json' -Force; Copy-Item 'public/manifest-pos.json' 'dist-pos/manifest.json' -Force; Remove-Item 'dist-pos/manifest-admin.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item 'dist-pos/manifest-pos.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" && npm run postbuild
